summary: This class discusses the custom of reading the Nesi'im during the first days of Nisan. It explains how this reading was done by anshe ma'aseh after prayers using special Pesah books rather than regular siddurim. The teacher outlines the complete order of readings, including passages from the Torah, Yehezqel, Tehilim, and Zohar.
